plan.campaign_summary: Three boundary-pushing concepts that challenge, inspire, and engage self-directed traders with the freedom of zero commission ETF trading.

concepts.name: Blueprints of Calm
concepts.strategic_idea: Capture the serene yet structured essence of trading, where precision meets tranquility.

visual_direction.description: A serene expanse of overlapping transparent grids, with soft light filtering through; evokes a sense of infinite possibility and calm.

copy_package.headline: THE CALM WITHIN THE TRADE.
copy_package.subheadline: Experience the zen of zero commission with every ETF trade.
copy_package.disclaimer: Caution. Investing involves risk of loss. Third party fees and Terms & conditions apply.

A polished sphere on a smooth surface, softly lit; no UI, no text on object.
